body.title: Bhushi Dam Waterfall Surge Tragedy
body.title_mr: भुशी धरण परिसरातील धबधब्यातून वाहून गेलेल्या दुर्घटनेची नोंद
body.location_name: Bhushi Dam Waterfall Behind Guest House
body.description: A family of five was swept away by a sudden, intense water surge while sitting on rocky cascades downstream of Bhushi Dam. Rapid runoff caused by intense localized rainfall in the unmonitored upstream catchment transformed a trickle into a torrential surge within 8 minutes.
body.source_name: Times of India & Pune Rural Police Incident Report
body.impact_summary: 5 lives lost. Prompted district administration to enforce Section 144 around tourist waterbodies during monsoon red alerts.

body.title: Bhor Ghat Expressway Boulder Fall & Mudflow
body.title_mr: मुंबई-पुणे द्रुतगती मार्गावर अमृतांजन पुलाजवळ दरड कोसळली
body.description: Massive 25-tonne basalt boulders detached from weathered escarpment joint planes after 210mm of 48-hour continuous rainfall, breaching wire rockfall catchment nets and obstructing Mumbai-bound lanes.
body.impact_summary: Traffic suspended for 7 hours. Heavy earthmovers and IRB infrastructure crews deployed for clearance.

body.title: Patan Village Escarpment Tension Crack & Mudslide
body.title_mr: पाटण गाव कड्यावर जमिनीला भेगा व दरड सरकणे
body.description: Sustained monsoon rain (280mm in 72 hours) saturated basalt overburden on a 30° slope above Patan village, causing ground fissures of 15cm width and localized mud slippage of 400 cubic meters.
body.impact_summary: Precautionary evacuation of 18 households to Bhangarwadi Municipal School. Zero casualties due to community alert.

body.title: Monkey Hill to Thakurwadi Rail Corridor Rockfall
body.title_mr: मंकी हिल ते ठाकूरवाडी दरम्यान रेल्वे ट्रॅकवर दरड
body.location_name: Central Railway Bhor Ghat Catchment km 118
body.description: A boulder fall damaged overhead railway traction equipment (OHE) and blocked the middle line between Monkey Hill and Thakurwadi during a nocturnal cloudburst.
body.impact_summary: Suburban and long-distance trains diverted via Daund-Pune or held at Karjat; cleared within 4.5 hours.

body.title: Adoshi Tunnel Hazardous Chemical Tanker Spill
body.title_mr: अडोशी बोगद्याजवळ केमिकल टँकर अपघात व वाहतूक कोंडी
body.description: Independent road incident: A multi-axle chemical tanker overturned near the Adoshi tunnel mouth, causing liquid cargo leakage and extensive 14km traffic snarl. Note: System explicitly records this as a vehicular/freight incident, not a natural hazard.
body.impact_summary: Hazardous material foam containment executed. Expressway traffic diverted to NH 48 for 6 hours.

body.title: Rajmachi Jungle Trail Stream Washout & Stranded Trekkers
body.title_mr: राजमाची मार्गावर ओढा वाहून गेल्याने ट्रेकर्स अडकले
body.description: Sudden seasonal stream surge washed away a temporary log bridge. 34 trekkers stranded on the Udhewadi side until Shivdurg Trekkers and local villagers secured a safety guideline rescue across the gorge.
body.impact_summary: All 34 trekkers rescued safely with zero injury. Highlights the need for upstream catchment early-warnings on remote trails.
